signals.title: Wikivoyage: Manali
signals.summary: === Climate === The climate in Manali is predominantly cold during winters, and moderately cool during summers. On average, some 45 mm (1.8 in) of precipitation is received during winter and spring months, increasing to some 115 mm (4.5 in) in summer as the monsoon approaches.
